item.text: The startup path confirms the failure: the Kubernetes service can run without invoking the uploader service that creates `log/upload/streaming/default`. I’ll initialize that uploader path there, and refactor session reuse so only short lived certificates are cached while each request gets fresh cluster and connection state. I’m also applying the requested config field names and preserving audit emission with the forwarder’s service context.
